title: Summary: samples and the time axis

clips.caption: Three things to keep: a <c.aqua>signal</c.aqua> is a quantity that changes over time; a <c.aqua>discrete signal</c.aqua> is described by <c.aqua>samples</c.aqua> and the sample interval; stem suits discrete samples better than plot.
The next section generates real <c.aqua>sine signals</c.aqua> and watches how <c.aqua>frequency</c.aqua> and <c.aqua>phase</c.aqua> change the waveform.
